findings.exact_problematic_wording: Bibliographic entries omit final volume/issue/pages for the two Reedlunn et al. 2013 papers.
findings.why_problem: The local Part I PDF is an unpaginated/xxx accepted-version extract and Part II is explicitly an accepted manuscript; repository evidence does not establish final volume/pages.
findings.source_evidence: Original PDFs verify authors, titles, journal, year and DOI but retain xxx/accepted-manuscript metadata.
findings.project_authority_evidence: Phase 6 and Phase 3 explicitly require conservative omission rather than guessed metadata.
findings.required_remediation: Retain DOI-only/conservative entries; do not invent volume/pages.

findings.exact_problematic_wording: V-W02 is cited as the publisher-verified early-access version dated Aug. 3, 2021.
findings.why_problem: The inspected publisher PDF is explicitly an online-first 2021 version and supplies no final volume/issue/pages.
findings.source_evidence: Publisher PDF cover states Published online: 03 Aug 2021 and DOI 10.1080/15376494.2021.1955313.
findings.project_authority_evidence: Phase 6 authority directs use of the online-first date without guessing later issue metadata.
findings.required_remediation: Keep online-first wording; no metadata expansion.
